_comment: Tunable gameplay numbers. Designers own this file. Change a number, refresh the browser.

player._movement: 'snappy' = instant start/stop. 'floaty' = accelerate and drift (uses acceleration + drag).

life._comment: Stamina max = seconds per year. Linear from staminaAt18 at startAge to staminaAtOld at oldAge, scaled by decayMult.

resources._comment: Each resource has current + max. 'drain' is per second. 'minMax' is the floor a max can erode to.

stations._comment: Effects applied after a mini-game. 'cur' is scaled by score (0..1). 'max' applies in full if score >= maxThreshold, negatives always apply.
